name: Auto Deco
description: Automatically decorates your level with real deco objects: grass, moss, vines, bushes, dots, studs, clouds and pixels.

style.name: Deco Style
style.description: Tropical: bright, multicolor look with foliage clusters, rising bubbles and long flowing dot ribbons (uses all 3 color channels). Hell: dark and sharp, with hanging thorns with glowing tips, spiky shard fans and rising embers (set the accent color to red or orange). Also recolors your blocks and saws if 'Hell: Recolor Blocks and Saws' is on. Others: Overgrown, Grass, Moss, Vines, Dots, Studs, Clouds, Floaty, Pixels, Mixed.

density.name: Density
density.description: How much deco is placed (0.05 to 1).

variation.name: Variation
variation.description: How much random tilt each piece gets (0 = perfectly straight).

scatter-radius.name: Float Radius (blocks)
scatter-radius.description: How far from blocks Floaty and Mixed pieces can appear.

vine-length.name: Vine Length
vine-length.description: Max pieces in each hanging vine (Vines style).

color-id-2.name: Detail Color Channel
color-id-2.description: Second color used by deco that has a detail layer.

color-id-3.name: Accent Color Channel
color-id-3.description: Third color. Tropical: a bright accent. Hell: the glow color for embers and tips.

hell-palette.name: Hell Palette (color channels)
hell-palette.description: Comma-separated color channels for Hell, darkest to brightest, e.g. 2,3,4,5,6. Give each channel a different red in the editor (maroon, blood red, crimson, orange-red, ember orange). Blocks, saws and deco blend smoothly across them, so the reds are never all the same.

glow.name: Glow
glow.description: Adds glow halos behind deco pieces and around blocks, saws, spikes, pads, orbs and portals. Works with every style.

glow-strength.name: Glow Strength
glow-strength.description: Higher = more glow layers and more glowing pieces.

glow-color-id.name: Glow Color Channel
glow-color-id.description: Color channel used for glow. In the editor set it to a bright orange or red, turn BLENDING on, and lower its opacity to about 20-30% so it looks like light instead of a solid disc.

depth-layer.name: Depth Layer
depth-layer.description: Adds a second layer of large, sparse pieces far behind everything, in the detail color, for a sense of depth.

include-hazards.name: Decorate Hazards
include-hazards.description: Also add deco around spikes and saws.

replace-old.name: Replace Previous Deco
replace-old.description: Removes grass, bush, dot, cloud and pixel objects already in the level before decorating. This also removes ones you placed by hand.

hell-retheme.name: Hell: Recolor Blocks and Saws
hell-retheme.description: With the Hell style, recolors every solid block (main + detail color) and every saw (dark blade, accent-color glow) already in your level. Old black saws are swapped for recolorable ones.
